summary: The child reports experiencing stuttering since they were around 2-3 years old, with it being particularly challenging for them as a toddler, but improving with the help of a stutter teacher. They mention that their stutter has recently worsened, particularly around the time of the COVID-19 pandemic, and can be triggered by stress or anxiety. The child also shares that they find stuttering to be a manageable aspect of their life and that they have found helpful tools and strategies to cope with it.
